Import.Title: Import character from AP app
Import.Hint: Select a JSON file exported from the AP character sheet app.
Import.SheetHint: Select a JSON file exported from the AP character sheet app. This replaces all data and items of {name}.

DefeatedTokens.Name: Defeated NPC tokens
DefeatedTokens.Hint: What happens to an NPC's token when "Apply to target" drops it to 0 HP. The actor in the Actors list is kept either way. Player characters are never affected.
DefeatedTokens.Remove: Remove (delete combatant and token after about 1 s)
DefeatedTokens.Mark: Mark only (status "dead", combatant defeated, token stays)

ConditionBar.Name: Show condition bar
ConditionBar.Hint: Narrow bar above the hotbar: a click sets a condition on every selected token, or on the current targets when nothing is selected. Drag it by the grip on the left.

ConditionBarGm.Name: Condition bar for the GM only
ConditionBarGm.Hint: Hides the condition bar from all players. The GM can still toggle it from the scene tool bar.

DiceTray.Label: Dice Tray
DiceTray.SettingHint: Show the dice tray below the chat input (only for you).
DiceTray.DieTooltip: d{faces} – click to add, right-click to remove, shift-click to roll
DiceTray.RerollHint: Reroll 1s (hit dice): every die showing 1 is rolled again
DiceTray.RollHint: Roll the formula (Enter in the formula field)
DiceTray.Empty: Nothing to roll: add dice or type a formula.
DiceTray.RollD20Hint: Roll d20 · Shift: advantage · Ctrl: disadvantage

Tower.Title: Tower Tracker
Tower.Speaker: Tower
Tower.HudSettingHint: Show the compact tower bar (level, element, quakes, time) below the scene controls while a tower run is active (only for you).
Tower.LeaveConfirm: End the tower run? A summary goes to the chat and the journal.
Tower.LastRun: Last run: level {level} reached, inside {inside}, outside {outside} h.
Tower.OpenJournal: Open the journal of this run
Tower.OffsetHint: Extra hours outside for special cases (may be negative).
Tower.IntervalHint: 0 = manual. Otherwise booking time triggers a quake every time the time on this level reaches a multiple of the interval.
Tower.NothingToUndo: Nothing to undo (level changes cannot be undone).

Collapse.Title: Level collapses
Collapse.Text: Third quake: level {level} collapses. The group lands uncontrolled one level higher.

Entry.Enter: Entered the tower on level {level} (world time {time})
Entry.Leave: Left the tower: level {level} reached, inside {inside}, outside {outside} h
